data.title: Mentoring session
data.transcript: Speaker 1: Can I be honest about why the milestone slipped? I've been having panic attacks, and my doctor has just started me on medication. Speaker 2: Thank you for telling me. Your health comes first. Speaker 1: Could we move the thesis milestone by a week? Speaker 2: Yes. I'll move your milestone to the following week and tell the committee only that the schedule changed. Speaker 1: Thank you, that really helps.
